# Workcell Source Languages

Intro prose before any subsection. Markdown is a prose lane, so nothing here
becomes a call edge.

## Installation

Install with `cargo add workcell-source-languages`.

### Prerequisites

- Rust 1.98
- A vendored grammar

## Usage

Run the dump example against a fixture.

Setext Level One
================

A setext H1 uses an underline of equals signs instead of a leading hash.

Setext Level Two
----------------

A setext H2 uses dashes.
